spans.s:
f. (-निट्)
Night: see निशा.

m. (-ठः)
The son of BALARĀMA.

n. (-नं)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 Hearing.
E.
नि before शम to be quiet, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 Looking at, beholding.
3 Looking at repeatedly.
4

Hearing.
5

A shadow, a reflexion.
E.
नि before शम to quiet, aff. ल्युट्.

ind.
Hearing, having heard.
E.
नि, शम to repose, ल्यप् aff.

ind.
Having put out, (as a light.)
2 Having tranquillized.
E.
नि before शम to be quiet, causal form, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Hearing.
E.
नि before शम to rest, शतृ aff.

ind. (-य्यः)
Having heard.
E.
नि before शमु to repose, ल्यप् aff., and अय inserted.

Night.
2

Turmerick, (Curcuma longa.)
3 Another sort, (C. zanthorrhiza)
E.
नि always, शो to waste or reduce, (mortals,) aff. क; or निश to meditate, aff. क्विप् and टाप् added.

(उ) निषु r. 1st cl. (नेषति)
To sprinkle.

m. (-रः)
1 The moon.
2 A cock.
E.
निशा night, and कर who makes or marks.

m. (-तुः)
The moon.
E.
निशा night, and केतु symbol.

m. (-णः)
A number of nights.
E.
निशा A night, and गण a class, a troop.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Nocturnal, night-walking, what goes or moves about by night.
m. (-रः)
1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or goblin.
2 A

Shakāl.
3

An owl.
4 A snake.
5 The ruddy goose.
6 A ghost, an evil spirit.
7 A thief.
f. (-री)
1 A woman who goes to an assignation, a harlot, a whore.
2 A she devil, a female fiend.
3 A sort of perfume: see केशिनी.
E.
निशा night, and चर् who goes.

n. (-र्म्म)
Darkness.
E.
निशा night, and चर्म्मन् skin or hide.

n. (-लं)
1 Frost, hoar frost.
2 Dew.
E.
निशा night, and जल water.

m. (-टः)
1 An owl.
2 A demon, a ghost.
E.
निशा night, and अट who goes; also with ल्यु aff. निशाटन m. (-नः.)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sharpened, polished, whetted, burnished.
E.
नि before शो to cut or pare, aff. क्त.

m. (-दः)
A man of a low caste: see निषाद.

m. (-दः)
A musical note: see निषाद.

m. (-दः)
1 The first of the seven musical notes, or more properly the last or highest of the scale.
2 A man of a degraded tribe, or an outcaste, especially the son of a Brahman by a Śūdra woman.
3 A fisherman.
E.
नि before षद to go, aff, घञ्; pervading the mind, &c.

n. (-त्वं)
The state or condition of a man of low caste.

m. (-र्शी)
An owl.
E.
निशा night, and दर्शिन् who sees.

f. (-दिः)
Evening, twilight.
E.
निशा, and आदि beginning.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Quiet, tranquil, patient.
n. (-न्तं)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 The end of the night, or break of day.
E.
नि before शम to be quiet, aff. क्त; or निशा night, अम to go, aff. क्त; or निशा as before, night, and अन्त end or term.

f. (-री)
A female, a housewife.
E.
निशान्त a house, नारी a woman.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Blind at night.
E.
निशा, and अन्ध blind.

m. (-तिः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
निशा night, and पति master.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 Hoar frost.
2

Dew.
3

The white water lily.
E.
निशा, and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-ङ्गा)
A plant commonly Dugdhapeya.
E.
निशा night, भङ्ग breaking.

m. (-णिः)
The moon.
E.
निशा night, and मणि a gem.

m. (-गः)
A Shakāl.
E.
निशा night, and मृग a deer.

n. (-णं)
1 Killing, slaying, slaughter.
2 Night combat.
E.
नि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. ल्युट्; or निशा night, and रण war.

m. (-त्नः)
The moon.
E.
निशा night, and रत्न jewel.

n. (-कं)
An air, a sort of musical composition, played as an accompaniment to dancing.

n. (-न्दं)
A number of nights.
E.
निशा, and वृन्द a many.

m. (-दी)
A cock.
E.
निशा night, and वेदिन् who knows.

m. (-सः)
The white water lily.
E.
निशा, and हस what smiles; opening its petals at night.

f. (-ह्वा)
Turmerick.
E.
निशा, and आह्वा appellation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sharpened, whetted.
n. (-तं)
Iron.
E.
नि before शो to pare, affix क्त.

f. (-ष्पा)
A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
E.
निशि by night, seventh case of निश्, and पुष्प flower, fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीप् affix निशिपुष्पी, and with कन् added निशिपुष्पिका the night-flower.

Midnight.
2

Night.
E.
नि always, शी to sleep, Uṇādi affix थक्.

f. (-नी)
Night.
E.
निशीथ as above, इनि aff.

m. (-थः)
The moon.
E.
निशीथिनी night, and नाथ lord.

f. (-थ्या)
Night.
E.
निशीथ midnight, and यत् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 The name of a giant slain by DURGĀ.
E.
नि before शुम्भ to hurt or kill, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaying, slaughter.
E.
see the last, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-नी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
निशुम्भ an Asura or demon so named, and मर्द्दिनी the female destroyer.

m. (-म्भी)
An inferior deity of the Bauddhas; also Heramba and Vajraṭīka.
E.
नि not, शुम्भ injuring, aff. इनि.

m. (-यः)
Resting at night.
E.
निशा, and उपशाय rest.

m. (-तः)
The Vaka, a crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
निशा by night, इत gone, to his roost.

m. (-यः)
Certainty, ascertainment, positive conclusion.
E.
निर् affirmative particle, चि to collect, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
Immoveable, still, fixed.
f. (-ला)
The earth.
E.
निर् privat. चल what goes or moves.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Firm, immoveable.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
2 A mountain, a rock.
E.
निश्चल, and अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what ascertains or determines.
E.
निर् before चि to collect, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Evacuation by stool.
2 Air, wind.
3 Obstinacy, wilfulness.
E.
निर् not, चर to go, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Certain, ascertained, determined, concluded.
2 Sentenced, pronounced.
n. (-तं)
Certainty, conclusion.
E.
निर् before चि to collect, क्त aff.

ind.
Having ascertained.
E.
निर aff. चि to collect, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Thoughtless, inconsiderate, void of reflexion.
E.
निर् neg. चिन्ता reflexion.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being in the course of ascertainment or conclusion, being under investigation.
E.
निर before चि to collect, शानच् aff., यक् inserted.

n. (-णं)
A sort of tooth-powder prepared of sulphate of iron, &c. it destroys the tartar, but blackens the teeth.
E.
निर् before चुक्क to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Powerless, helpless.
2 Incapable of effort.
E.
निर् neg. चेष्टा effort.

n. (-सं)
Final emancipation: see निःश्रेयस.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Conferring final happiness or emancipation.
E.
निश्श्रेयस, and कर what makes.

n. (-नं)
1 Breathing out, expiration.
2 Sighing.
E.
निर् forth, and श्वसन breathing.

m. (-सः)
1 Breath expired, breathing out, expiration.
E.
निर् out, and श्वास breath.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A quiver.
2 Union, meeting, association.
E.
नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घञ् a collection of arrows, &c.

m. (-थिः)
1 Embracing, an embrace.
2 A bowman.
3 A charioteer.
4 A car.
5

Grass.
6

The shoulder.
E.
नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घ and थिन् Uṇādi aff. added.

m. (-ङ्गी)
An archer, a bowman.
E.
निषङ्ग a quiver, and इनि aff.

f. (-द्या)
1 A market.
2 A small bed.
E.
नि before षद to go, क्यप् aff.

m. (-रः)
Mud, mire.
f. (-री)
Night.
E.
नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. ष्वरच्.

m. (-धः)
1 The name of a mountain or mountainous range, forming one of the principal ranges of the universe, and described as lying immediately south of Hāvrata, and north of the Himāla range.
2 A country in the south-east division of

India.
3

The sovereign of Niṣadha.
4 A musical note; also निषाद्र.
5 Hard, solid.
E.
नि before षद to go, aff. अच् and द irregularly changed to ध.

mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
1 Placed in or on.
2 Gone to.
3 Rested, reclined.
E.
नि before षद to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-खं)
Seating, seated.
m. (-कं)
A seat.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-कः)
A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata.)

m. (-दी)
An elephant keeper or driver.
E.
नि before षद to go, aff. णिनि.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Prohibited, forbidden.
E.
नि priv. सिध to complete, aff. क.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
1 Sitting, sitting upon.
2 Standing or resting in or on.
E.
नि before षद to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
नि before षद to kill, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
नि before षद to kill, aff, ल्युट्; also निषूदन.

m. (-कः)
1 The ceremony performed upon impregnation taking place.
2 Sprinkling, aspersion.
3

Effusion.
4

Seminal effusion.
E.
नि, and षिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वस्)
Sitting, seated on or upon.
E.
नि before सद to go, क्वसु aff.

n. (-धः)
1 Prohibition, negation.
2 Stop, discontinuance.
3 Contrariety to or deviation from rule, irregularity, exception.
E.
नि before सिध to complete, aff. घञ्.

Service.
2

Observance, practice, adherence to.
E.
नि before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be served, to be obeyed.
2 To be observed or followed.
E.
नि before सेव to serve, अनीयर् aff.; also निषेवितव्य, and निषेव्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Observed, practised.
2 Served, obeyed.
3 Frequented through respect.
E.
नि before सेव to serve, क्त aff.

r. 10th cl. (निष्कयते)
To measure or weigh.

mn. (-ष्कः-ष्कं)
1 A weight of gold, applied however to different quantities: it is considered as synonymous with the Dīnāra of thirty-two small, or sixteen large Rettīs; with the Karṣa or Suvarṇa of sixteen Māṣas; with the Pala of four or five Suvarṇas; and with the larger Pala or Dināra, which is sometimes reckoned at 108, and other times at 150

Suvarṇas.
2

Gold in general.
3 Any ornament of the breast.
4 An ornament of the neck.
5 A weight of four Māṣas.
6 A weight of silver of four

Suvarṇas.
7

A value of sixteen Kahans or Dramyas.
E.
नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्, and the radical final rejected.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Without thorns.
2 Free from trouble.
E.
निर् neg. कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A plant, (Capparis trifoliata,) &c.: see वरुणा.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c.
E.
निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Cruel, unpitying, unmerciful.
E.
निर् neg. करुण compassionate.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Waned, diminished.
2 Impotent, seedless, barren.
m. (-लः)
1 Pudendum muliebre.
2 A name of

BRAHMA.
3

A fancied personification of BRAHMA, for religious ceremonies.
f. (-ला or -ली)
A woman past child bearing, in whom menstruation has ceased.
E.
निर् gone, lost, कल a part, &c.

m. (-र्षः)
Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
निर् before कृष to plough, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Free from wish or desire.
n. adv. (-मं)
Unwillingly.
E.
निर् neg. काम desire.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Causeless, groundless.
E.
निर् neg. कारण cause.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Of a noble race, not degraded.

m. (-कः)
A penitent, shaved and smeared with Ghee.

m. (-शः)
A portico, a veranda.
E.
निर्, and कश to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Expelled: see the next.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Expelled, dismissed, turned out.
2 Gone forth or out, issued.
3 Placed, deposited.
4 Placed over, appointed, stationed.
5 Reviled, reproached.
6 Opened out, blown, expanded.
E.
निर् out, कस to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त, र becomes ष or Visarga: see निःकासित; also निष्काशित.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Who or what expels.
(-नी)
A female slave not restrained by her master.
E.
निर् forth, कस to go, causal form, णिनि aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A grove near a house.
2 A field.
3 A door.
4 The private apartments, the Zenana. (E. निर् without, कुट the house.)
f. (-टा, also टिः or टी)
Large cardamoms.
E.
निर out, कुट the shell or husk, aff. क, with टाप् fem. aff. or कि with ङीष् optionally added.

m. (-म्भः)
A plant, commonly Danti.
E.
निर् forth, स्कुम्भ a Sautra root, to spread, aff. अच्; also निःकुम्भ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Expelled, extracted, forced or drawn out.
E.
निर् neg. कुष to extract, aff. क्त.

m. (-हः)
The hollow of a tree.
E.
निर् affirmative prefix, कुह to astonish, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Regardless, negligent.
2 Disregarded, thought nothing of.
3

Pardoned.
4

Undone.
E.
निर् neg. कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
1 Pardon, absolution.
2

Expiration.
3

Escaping from, avoiding the consequence of any thing.
4 Undoing, doing away.
5 Disregarding, neglecting.
6 Acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation.
E.
निर् neg. कृति doing.

n. (-नं)
1 Taking away.
2 Extracting, extirpating.
E.
निर् before कुष to expel, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be taken away.
E.
निर् out, कुष to expel, तव्य aff.; also निष्कोषणीय.

m. (-मः)
1 Any intellectual faculty, as attention, comprehension, &c.
2 Degradation, baseness, inferiority of tribe, family, &c.
3 Going out, exit.
E.
निर् assuredly or forth, and क्रम going.

n. (-णं)
1 Going forth or out.
2 Taking a child for the first time out of the house, in the fourth month, considered as an essential ceremony, and accompanied by sacrifice, &c.
E.
निर् forth, क्रमण going.

ind.
Going forth.
E.
निर्, क्रम to go, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-यः)
Hire, wages.
E.
निर् before क्री to buy, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Gone out, gone, departed.
E.
निर् out, क्रम to go, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Abstaining from ceremonial rites.
2 Idle, unoccupied.
n. (-यं)
BRAHMA or the Supreme Spirit.
E.
निर् neg. क्रिया act.

m. (-थः)
Broth, soup.
E.
निर् before क्वथ to decoct, aff. घञ्.

m. (-ष्ट्यः)
A man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Well done, dressed or cooked.
2 Burnished, made bright.
E.
निर्, and तप्त heated.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Staying, being in, who or what stays or is in or on any thing.
2 Believing, faithful.
f. (-ष्ठा)
1 The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of a fable.
2 Conclusion in general, end, termination.
3 Disappearance, loss, [] destruction.
4 Confirmation, completion.
5 Asking, begging.
6 Ordinary and uniform practice or profession.
7 Good conduct, excellence.
8 Religious practice, devout and austere exercise.
9 Faith, belief.
10 Condition, state.
11 Fixed time of life, &c.
12 Trouble, distress, anxiety.
13 The technical term for the past participial affixes क्त and क्तवतु.
E.
नि completely, assuredly, स्था to stay or stop, अङ् and टाप affs.

n. (-नं)
Sauce, condiment.
E.
नि before स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Firm, fixed.
2 Certain, ascertained.
3 Engaged in, attached to, devoted to.
4 Staying, being in or on.
E.
नि before स्था to stay, क्त aff.

m. (-वः)
Spitting: see निष्ठेव.

m. (-नं)
Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.
E.
नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. ल्युट्; also निष्ठेवन and निष्ठीव.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Harsh, contumelious, (as speech.)
2 Hard, solid.
E.
नि before स्था to be, to be firm, aff. कुरच्.

f. (-ता)
Harshness of speech, reviling, abuse.
E.
निष्ठुर, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, निष्ठुरत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cast, thrown, sent, directed, dispatched.
2 Ejected from the mouth, spit.
E.
नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.

f. (-तिः)
Spitting, spitting out.
E.
नि before ष्ठिव to eject from the mouth, aff. क्त.

subst. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth.
E.
नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. घञ्; also निष्ठीव.

n. (-नं)
Spitting.
E.
see the last; also निष्ठीव.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Skilful, &c. see the next.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Skilful, clever, conversant, learned.
2 Perfect, superior, supreme.
3 (In law,) Agreed upon.
E.
नि before स्ना to bathe, aff. क्त; also with ड, निष्ण.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Decocted, infused, boiled.
E.
निर् before पक्व ripe or cooked.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Pure, free from mud or filth.
E.
निर् neg. पङ्क mud.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
Issuing, going forth or out.
E.
निर् before पत to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Going forth or out, issuing.
E.
निर्, and पतन going.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Completion, conclusion, termination, consummation.
2 Birth, production.
3 Going forth or out.
E.
निर् negative, पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-तिः)
Excessive bodily pain.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Motionless.
E.
निर् not, स्पदि to shake or move, aff. अच्; also निष्पन्न.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Still, steady, immoveable.
m. (-न्दः)
Throbbing, trembling.
E.
नि before स्पद to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Done, finished, concluded, completed.
2 Born, produced.
3

Motionless.
4

Gone forth or out of.
E.
निर् affirmation or negation, and पन्न gone, from पद to go, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
Drinking.
E.
निर् before पान drinking.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Weak, destitute of power.
E.
निर् neg. पराक्रम valour.

m. (-हः)
An ascetic, one who has no family nor dependants.
E.
निर् neg. परिग्रह dependants.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Doing, effecting, accomplishing.
2

Concluding.
3

Producing, causing, engendering.
E.
निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done, effected, made, produced.
E.
निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
To be done, to be effected or accomplished.
E.
निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, यत् aff.; also निष्पादनीय and निष्पादयितव्य.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being done or made, in the course of completion.
E.
निर् before पद to go, causal form, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Certain, indubitable.
m. (-वः)
1 Winnowing, cleaning corn, &c.
2 Wind, air.
3 The wind of the winnowing sieve or basket.
4 Straw, chaff.
5 A legume, a pod.
6 A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
E.
निर् before पू to purify, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Ground, reduced to dust or powder.
2 Beaten, oppressed.
E.
निर्, and पिष्ट ground.

m. (-त्त्रः-त्त्रा-त्त्रं)
Sonless.
E.
निर्, and पुन्त्र a son.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Feminine, neuter, not male.
m. (-षः)
1 A eunuch or impotent man.
2 A coward.
E.
निर् neg. पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic^1, ignorant.
E.
निर् privative, प्रतिभ brilliance.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Unobstructed, unimpeded.
n. adv. (-हं)
Freely, without hindrance.
E.
निर् neg. प्रत्यूह obstacle.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Gloomy, dark, obscure.
E.
निर् privative, and प्रभा light.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Causeless, groundless.
E.
निर् negative, प्रयोजन motive, cause.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Content, not envying any person, nor coveting any thing.
f. (-हा)
A plant; also अमूला and विष्णुघल्लभा.
E.
निर् not, स्पृहा envy, &c.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Content, unenvious.
f. (-हा)
1 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.)
2 Contentment.
E.
नि neg. स्पृहा desire.

mfn. subst. (-णः-णी-णं)
New and unbleached cloth.
E.
निर् gone, प्रकाणी here said to mean the weaver's brush; also निष्प्रवाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) the forms are irregular.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Barren, unfruitful.
2 Seedless, impotent.
f. (-ला or -ली)
A woman past child bearing, one in whom menstruation has ceased: see निष्कल.
E.
निर् priv. and फल fruit.

m. (-तः)
Midnight; also निःसम्पात.

m. (-र्गः)
1 The natural state, nature, peculiar character or condition.
2

Form.
3

Creation.
4

Relinquishment, abandoning.
5 Transfer, barter.
E.
नि before सृज to create, or to abandon, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Cognate, innate.
2 Produced at creation.
E.
निसर्ग, and ज produced.

m. (-न्धुः)
A shrub, (Vitex negundo); it is also read निसिन्ध, and with कन् added निसुन्धक; the words are considered as barbarous: see सिन्धुवार.

f. (-ता)
A plant, commonly Teöri.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Delivered, deposited.
2 Centrical, middle.
E.
नि before सृज to go, aff. क्त.

m. (-र्थः)
A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador: one who decides upon his own discretion, knowing the intentions of both parties.
E.
निसृष्ट deposited, अर्थ meaning.

f. (-नी)
A pill, a bolus, a sort of force-meat ball.
E.
नि before स्तन a breast, ङीप् diminutive aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Going out or forth.
2 Crossing over or passing.
3 Extraction, getting rid of or free from.
4 Means of success, an expedient, a plan.
E.
निर् before तॄ to cross or pass over, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Paralysed, numbed.
2 Stopped, fixed.
E.
नि before स्तम्भ to stop, aff. क्त.

n. (-णं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
निर् before तृह to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Round, globular.
2 Trembling, shaking, moving.
3 Down, below.
E.
निर् negative or affirmative, and तल a support or stay; or depth, bottom.

m. (-रः)
1 Getting over or across.
2 Getting rid of, or away from, extraction, escape.
3 Acquittance, requital.
4 Means, expedient.
5 Final liberation.
E.
निर्, and तॄ to cross, घञ् aff.

n. (-जं)
The cause of final liberation, faith in any deity, &c.
E.
निस्तार, and वीज seed.

mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्)
1 Desirous or anxious to cross.
2 Wishing for salvation, or to traverse the world.
E.
निर् before तॄ to cross, desid. form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Freed from the chaff, (corn, &c.)
E.
निर् neg. तुष chaff.

m. (-रः)
Wheat.
E.
निस्तुष, and क्षीर milk.

n. (-त्नं)
Crystal.
E.
निस्तुष, and रत्न a gem.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left, abandoned, deserted.
2 Skinned, peeled.
3 Pared, made thin.
E.
निर् before तुष husk or skin, converted into a nominal verb, and क्त participial aff.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
1 Dull, obscure.
2 Dull, spiritless.
3 Powerless, impotent.
E.
निर् neg. तेजस् light, &c.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Fearless, unapprehensive.
E.
निर् neg. त्रशि to fear, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Merciless, unfeeling, unpitying.
m. (-शः)
A scimitar, a sacrificial knife.
E.
निर् forth, त्रिंशत् thirty, ड aff.; being of thirty finger's length, &c.

m. (-री)
A soldier armed with a sword.
E.
निस्त्रिंश, and धारिन् who bears.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Destitute of the qualities, truth, passion, and darkness.
E.
निर् neg. त्रैगुण्य three qualities.

m. (-वः)
The remainder of articles, &c. after a sale or market.

m. (-न्दः)
Trickling, oozing, issuing.
E.
नि before स्यन्द to ooze, aff. अच्.

m. (-वः)
The scum of boiled rice.
E.
नि before स्रु to ooze or drop, aff. घञ्.

Sound.
2

Silence.
E.
नि before स्वन to sound, aff. अप्.

m. (-नः)
Sound.
E.
नि before स्वन with घञ् aff.: see the last.

m. (-रः)
1 A warm cloth, a blanket.
2 Curtains, musquito curtains.
